title: ageratina saltillensis
intro: Ageratina saltillensis, commonly known as Tree Marigold or Mexican Mint Marigold, is a medicinal plant native to Mexico. This plant has been used for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which can help in reducing fever, relieving digestive issues, and treating skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Ageratina saltillensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Ageratina saltillensis contribute to its potential use in traditional medicine for treating various health conditions, including respiratory and gastrointestinal disorders.
